descriptor: A simple web-based booking management system for salon owners, integrating with Gmail for communication and ensuring correct customer contact information.

requirements.statement: The system must provide a web-based UI for salon owners to manage bookings.
The system must verify correct customer contact information before confirming a booking.
The system must flag bookings for manual review when availability is uncertain.
The system must show all prepared bookings to the salon owner before sending confirmations.
The system must integrate with Gmail for sending booking confirmations.

releases.demo: Show a booking being created, verified, flagged for review, and displayed for owner approval before sending via Gmail.
releases.goal: Establish the basic booking management system with verification and review features.
releases.name: Initial Setup and Verification

releases.demo: Demonstrate enhanced booking management capabilities with improved UI and error handling.
releases.goal: Improve the booking management process with additional features and optimizations.
releases.name: Enhanced Booking Management

releases.demo: Showcase a more intuitive and user-friendly interface for managing bookings.
releases.goal: Enhance the user interface and experience for salon owners.
releases.name: User Experience Improvements

releases.demo: Demonstrate faster booking processing and reliable system performance under load.
releases.name: Performance Optimization

stories.title: Create and verify a booking
stories.narrative: As a salon owner, I want to create a booking and verify customer contact information, so that I can ensure accurate bookings.
acceptance: Given a new booking request, When I enter customer contact information, Then the system verifies the information is correct.
Given incorrect contact information, When I try to confirm the booking, Then the system flags the error and prevents confirmation.
Trust: Given a booking creation, When contact info is verified, Then it is logged for audit.
stories.task_guidance: Implement the booking creation form and integrate contact verification logic.

stories.title: Flag uncertain bookings for review
stories.narrative: As a booking manager, I want to flag uncertain bookings for review, so that they can be verified before confirmation.
acceptance: Given a booking with missing information, when I review it, then it is flagged for further action.
Given a booking with all required information, when I review it, then it is not flagged.
Trust: Every flagged booking is recorded with a reason for the flag.
stories.task_guidance: Implement a flagging system in the booking review interface to mark uncertain bookings.

stories.title: Review and approve prepared bookings
stories.narrative: As a salon owner, I want to review all prepared bookings before they are sent, so that I can ensure accuracy.
acceptance: Given prepared bookings, When I review them, Then I can approve or edit before sending.
Given a booking error, When I review, Then I can correct it before approval.
Trust: Given a booking review, When approved, Then the approval is logged.
stories.task_guidance: Develop the booking review interface and approval workflow.

stories.title: Send booking confirmations and update status
stories.narrative: As a booking manager, I want to send booking confirmations and update the booking status, so that customers are informed and records are accurate.
acceptance: Given a confirmed booking, when I send a confirmation, then the customer receives an email via Gmail.
Given a booking without an email address, when I attempt to send a confirmation, then I receive an error message.
Trust: Every sent confirmation is logged with a timestamp and booking ID.
stories.task_guidance: Use the Gmail API to send confirmation emails and update the booking status in the database.

stories.title: Enhance booking UI for better user experience
stories.narrative: As a salon owner, I want an improved booking UI, so that I can manage bookings more efficiently.
acceptance: Given the booking UI, When I use it, Then it is intuitive and user-friendly.
Given a UI error, When I encounter it, Then the system provides helpful feedback.
Trust: Given UI interactions, When completed, Then they are logged.
stories.task_guidance: Redesign the booking UI for better usability and feedback.
